|lore=Mennotor DAS-430 electromagnetic projectile launcher. Often mistaken for a blaster rifle. Fires small hollow darts filled with neurotoxin which cause temporary paralysis.
|game_text=Deploy on any bounty hunter for 1 Force (free on IG-88). May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target captured if destiny +1 > defense value. If a card with a maintenance cost or permanent weapon is captured, opponent must lose 2 Force.

|notes=The Players Committee released the original-layout slip for IG-88's Neural Inhibitor on 30 May 2003. The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[IG-88's Neural Inhibitor (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[IG-88's Neural Inhibitor (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. Both editions keep the deployment and targeting costs, capture threshold, and a 2-Force loss after a qualifying capture. The remastered slip represents Maintenance and Permanent Weapon with their icons.
